incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 3109876543 - Arcturus Systems (enterprise) contact-routing failures detected. Automated alert: 5xx spikes and routing TTL errors on eu-west-1 dedicated pool.
Sam Chen: seeing high 502/504 from dedicated gateways to Arcturus routes. Dashboard shows spike started ~09:12 UTC. Paging Eng oncall.
Lexi Morales: @oncall-sre I'm shipping logs to the incident channel. TL;DR — prefix cache miss + downstream auth failing for a subset of customer routes.
oncall-sre: ACKed. Investigating reachability to Arcturus dedicated pool (10.4.x).
Maria Khatri: pinging infra team for network path check and router ACLs. Also checking whether recent rollback to runtime v2.14 touched routing logic.
Jared Voss: I deployed a hotfix earlier but it was scoped to model-selection, not routing. Will review commit list.
Sam Chen: quick mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback routing to shared-hosted tier for Arcturus routes, 2) enable temporary bypass of prefix cache for their traffic to force cold KV retrieval, 3) notify customers and update status page. Can someone prepare contact list / tailored notice?
Account Ops: we have primary contacts for Arcturus:
  - Engineering: eng-lead@arcturus.example.com / +1-555-0199 (primary)
  - Platform Ops: ops@arcturus.example.com / +1-555-0200 (secondary)
  - Legal/Procurement: contracts@arcturus.example.com
Also their routing policy: primary dedicated pool eu-west-1 -> fallback hosted-west if dedicated unavailable.
Lexi Morales: drafting customer notification below — feel free to iterate.
Sam Chen: rolling the fallback now. Command: 
```bash
# enable fallback for tenant arcturus
redwoodctl routes set-fallback --tenant arcturus --to hosted-west --ttl 300
```
incident-bot: deploy-runner: job 98412 started by Sam Chen.
oncall-sre: fallback applied, verifying traffic. Initial checks: 70% routed to hosted-west, latency increased ~40ms but error rate dropping.
Maria Khatri: network team reports asymmetric route caused certificates to mismatch for a subset; they're reverting a change to ACLs from earlier this morning. ETA 20m.
Sam Chen: draft status page update (please review):
"We are currently investigating elevated errors affecting Arcturus Systems' dedicated inference routing in eu-west-1. We have applied a temporary fallback to our hosted tier for affected traffic which reduces errors while we remediate the dedicated pool. Impact: some requests may see slightly higher latency and tokenization differences for long-context queries. Next update in 30 minutes or when new info is available."
Lexi Morales: suggested customer email (short version):
"Hi Arcturus team — we’re investigating degraded request success rates for your dedicated routing in eu-west-1. We applied a temporary fallback to our hosted tier to restore request success. You may observe modestly increased latency. No data was exfiltrated; this is a routing/availability issue. We’ll follow up with a post-incident summary. — Sam, Redwood Inference"
Account Ops: adding targeted contact routing notes: if primary does not acknowledge in 10m escalate to +1-555-0200 and copy legal. Also prepare enterprise status page incident link and include dedicated contract SLA ID: DED-EU-ARCT-001.
Jared Voss: I’m going to revert the bridge ACL change as Maria suggested. Pushing revert now.
incident-bot: revert job 98413 started by Jared Voss.
oncall-sre: after revert, we see certificate negotiation success rate improving to 99.2% from 85%. Holding on completing rollback verification.
Sam Chen: can someone craft the tailored customer impact statement for their public-facing status page? Need to include expected timeline and mitigation.
Lexi Morales: Status page paragraph suggestion:
"We detected intermittent routing failures affecting Arcturus Systems' dedicated eu-west-1 environment, impacting inference request success for some customers. We applied an immediate fallback to our hosted tier and reverted a recent network ACL change. We estimate full restoration for the dedicated pool within 15-30 minutes while we confirm stability. If you have concerns, contact eng-lead@arcturus.example.com (primary) or support@redwood.com."
Maria Khatri: verification monitors show error budget HEALED. RTT steady. Recommend holding fallback for 30m after stable metrics then migrate back using gradual canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
oncall-sre: scheduling handoff: I’ll be on-call for next 2 hours, after that @Jared Voss will take over.
Sam Chen: handoff notes to include in the on-call rotation:
  - Incident ID: 3109876543
  - Root cause: a recent network ACL change caused certificate mismatch and selective routing failures for dedicated pool; exacerbated by prefix cache cold miss on tenant-specific routes.
  - Mitigations applied: ACL revert, temporary fallback to hosted tier, KV prefix bypass for Arcturus, rollback verification completed.
  - Next steps: monitor for 30m stable metrics, perform gradual migration back to dedicated pool, prepare post-incident report with timeline and impact quantification.
Account Ops: prepared tailored customer notify (full):
"Subject: Service interruption notice — Arcturus Systems (eu-west-1)
Hi Arcturus team,
At 09:12 UTC we observed elevated failure rates for requests routed to your dedicated eu-west-1 pool. Root cause: a network ACL change earlier today caused certificate negotiation failures for a subset of connections and triggered routing errors.
Actions taken:
  - We reverted the ACL change and verified certificate negotiation success.
  - We applied a temporary fallback to our hosted tier to restore request success while we validate the dedicated pool.
  - We bypassed prefix cache for your tenant to prevent stale KV references while connectivity stabilizes.
Impact: Some requests may have returned 5xx errors between 09:12–09:30 UTC. Since mitigation, success rate is >99% but you may see slightly increased latency while on fallback.
SLA / next steps: We plan to migrate traffic back to the dedicated pool via a canary rollout over the next 30 minutes. A post-incident report with timelines and affected request counts will follow. For urgent escalation, contact eng-lead@arcturus.example.com and ops@arcturus.example.com.
Apologies for the disruption — Sam Chen, Redwood Inference"
Lexi Morales: sending the draft status page update and customer email now.
incident-bot: incident status set to "mitigated" by Lexi Morales. Next update scheduled in 30 minutes.
oncall-sre: metrics stable for 18 minutes. Preparing canary rollback to dedicated pool at 09:58 UTC.
Sam Chen: final note to handoff: keep an eye on tokenization diffs for long queries (we suspect cached tokenizer mismatch). If we see >1% regression, rollback to fallback and open a follow-up investigation.
Jared Voss: ACK. I’ll own the postmortem and schedule cross-team RCA.
Account Ops: closing loop — Arcturus acknowledged receipt and asked for the postmortem timeline. I set stakeholder expectation for a 48h post-incident report.
incident-bot: incident 3109876543 closed at 10:02 UTC (status: resolved -> postmortem required).
